column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, tracking ...). One entry per line, `#` comments, blank lines ignored.
# A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes (`faktur*`: `faktura`, `faktury`).
# Entries are written as the historical lists spelled them (accents where they had them);
# the rules check matches both spellings, the NER check folds entries like text.
# A trailing `.` matches with or without the dot (`sygn`/`sygn.`); an entry may hold a space
# (`sygn. akt`). Truncated stems (`zamowien*`, `zgloszen*`, `sledzeni*`) fold to the
# historical negative-cue stems they replace. Optional second column: `both` (the default:
# the rules check and the NER check read it), `rules` (the rules check only) or `ner`
# (the NER check only), `weak` (LAB-1293: a poor negative cue such as an amount or generic
# reference word, honored by the rules check only; the NER check ignores it, as before).
